t: This is Target House, a modern commercial building at 66 St James's Street, on the corner with St James's Place. It was designed by Rodney Gordon of Tripos Architects, a British modernist. Gordon worked mainly in concrete and was called a brutalist. His buildings have been described as dramatic, sculptural and enormous, and even futuristic. He was also the primary architect of the Tricorn Centre in Portsmouth and Trinity Square in Gateshead.
